tags.feature: Unlock Rush Mode after collecting enough cards.
In Rush Mode, you’ll use one deck to face 9 opponents in a row: 6 standard enemies and 3 bosses.
You can preview which Magibricks each opponent will use.
At the start of Rush Mode, choose 10 cards to build your deck.
You have only one life—no resets or retries within a run. Plan every placement carefully: a single defeat sends you back to the beginning.
Complete Rush Mode to earn exclusive cards and achievements.
Jiebo （the Panda）
Plays White, excels at board setup, and will strike hard in the late game.
Zhan （the Owl）
Plays Black, specializes in territory control, but sometimes lets victories slip through carelessness.
This update also adds new cards and revises the end-of-match flow (so you may encounter untested bugs). Please report any issues!

notes.title: Small Updates and Future Plans
notes.content:
Long time no see! Recently, I’ve been focused on porting Magibrick (mobile and NS versions) and experimenting with new game ideas, which is why updates have been delayed.

This patch mainly includes:

[list]
[*]Minor bug fixes
[*]UI optimizations and display improvements
[/list]

Planned Updates (within 1-2 months)

[*]A fresh gameplay mode
[/list]

Thank you for your support! Feel free to share ideas in the comments below!

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support and for playing the game! Over the past two weeks since launch, we’ve received a lot of feedback. We’ve noticed that some levels’ difficulty and the sudden attacks from late-game enemies have been the main factors leading to poor player experiences. To address this, we’ve spent significant time optimizing the difficulty of all levels and rebalancing the abilities of enemy bricks.

Here are the main updates in this patch:

1. Optimized the difficulty of all levels, especially in the early stages.
2. Introduced a new Countdown mechanic for enemies. Some important enemy abilities will now use this 
new system, giving players more time to prepare and counter them.
3.Adjusted certain cards. The Abyssal Mammoth has regained its two tentacles, and the Stone Lion no longer spawns a strange “middle stone lion” after upgrading.
4.Adjusted the "Sprite Trials" . Players can now reset the challenges unlimited times, and the rewards have been optimized to guarantee an upgraded version of the Sprite card.
5.Fixed some known bugs.

Lastly, I’ve noticed that many players have mentioned “relics” and “shops.” I’d like to apologize, as from the very beginning of this project, I decided not to confine the game to the framework of Slay the Spire. Thus, these two systems were never planned. However, “relics” may appear in some other form in the future, as the current first-round rewards do feel a bit lackluster.

I hope everyone continues to provide feedback, and thank you again for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2762650/_/

notes.title: Slow Update
notes.content:
Old News: Postponed Participation in the Next Fest
On June 9th, we made the difficult decision to withdraw the last week's Next Fest. The primary reason for this decision is that we have begun discussions with some publishers, and after comprehensive deliberation, we decided that participating in the Next Fest Oct would be a better choice.

1.Bug Fixes

We fixed some known bugs, including errors in card descriptions and skill bugs. Additionally, we reconstructed the logic for face-down monster bricks, ensuring they still function as monster bricks.

2.Portal Node Optimization

We fixed the logic for the Chaos Portal card transformation to prevent it from giving unintended cards to players. We also noticed that the randomness of the portal nodes was too high, causing players to avoid them. Now, entering a portal node will allow players to choose between two different portals.

3. Rune Cross Rework

The original Rune Cross has been changed to "Nyx: Rune," but the method for obtaining Sorcery Stone remains the same.

4.First Boss Difficulty Reduction

The Green Lord's fearsome abilities now only activate during the first 5 turns.

5. Font Size Optimization

Bigger Letters!

6. Card Unlock Method Changes

Some card unlock methods have been modified, which might affect players with older save files! If you encounter any issues, please join the channel for feedback: https://discord.gg/rs2yS4uJd3

Additionally, Magibrick will participate in the CCG Expo in Shanghai on July 4th. Come and try out the latest version in Expo! We look forward to your participation!

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.content:
1. Reduce Difficulty of Levels
I've received feedback that the difficulty curve of the demo becomes painful after the tutorial. Therefore, I've adjusted the initial level difficulty without removing the higher difficulty levels. The more challenging levels will appear as you progress in the game.

2. Temporary Removal of Deck Adjustment at Start
Based on some feedback, I believe this feature added complexity for new players and reduced the smoothness of starting the game quickly. Therefore, this feature has been temporarily removed. It may return in the future as an unlockable upgrade.

3. Fixed Some Bugs of Locations

Looking forward to your comments and feedback!
